cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Hope Keeps Moving
cards.instruction: Turn every disappointment into a new reason the desired outcome is delayed, redirected, or becoming more meaningful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The hall rejected our wedding booking. Cross it off neatly, please. A refusal tells us which venue wasn't right for us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Every venue is booked for June.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then turn to September. Not August; we need time to plan properly. Three extra months will make the wedding worth waiting for.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My parents can't travel in September.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we go to them. Put 'their garden' on the list, please, and ring your mum before you confirm anything. We needed somewhere she'd actually be.

reason: Replace the thematic people-before-venue summary with reassurance about this specific mother's presence, preserving pending permission.
